author: Zegita
body:
So my previous thread got locked and I have gathered much evidence now to the fact why my ban was a bit over the top.

Firstly, I know I have had infractions in the past but please do not use that to go against me. Speaking of infractions however, my ban was for "Please don't be disrespectful towards other players" and I have evidence that I was not. I'd also like to mention that I am sorry to Pelpelajax because I was irritated by the fact that I thought a player was hacking. I've learnt from this mistake and I'll try my best not do it again.

Secondly, I'd like to point out that the fact for my ban was apparently being disrespectful towards OTHER players and the only player I was apparently being "disrespectful" to was Pel himself. I have evidence that I wasn't fully being disrespectful to him e.g "oh f*** you and you're a sh** mod etc. Here is the evidence:

[20:25:19] [Client thread/INFO]: [CHAT] Zegita » fucking pel
[20:25:20] [Client thread/INFO]: [CHAT] Zegita » do ur job
[20:25:20] [Client thread/ERROR]: Item entity 46030 has no item?!
[20:25:24] [Client thread/INFO]: [CHAT] Your report has been sent to online staff successfully.
[20:25:25] [Client thread/INFO]: [CHAT] MiaKhaIifa was slain by Ek_Chuah's diamond sword
[20:25:27] [Client thread/INFO]: [CHAT] MOD | Pelpelajax » He's not hacking,
[20:25:32] [Client thread/INFO]: [CHAT] ABVAZXOETYUWWHZZ was slain by PandaTonio's iron sword
[20:25:36] [Client thread/INFO]: [CHAT] ABVAZXOETYUWWHZZ » i have no idea
[20:25:36] [Client thread/INFO]: [CHAT] lavatron900? » o u made a bridge to the monuments atleast
[20:25:40] [Client thread/INFO]: [CHAT] (Tip) Earn credits up to 2.5x faster with a premium rank!
[20:25:44] [Client thread/INFO]: [CHAT] Frisbee126 fell from a high place
[20:25:46] [Client thread/INFO]: [CHAT] Zegita » how about u actually face him and then see for urself

The only words that I said that could possibly have been disrespectful were "fuck*** pel do your job". Where I said "how about you actually face him and then see for urself" was definitely not disrespectful as I was just trying to tell him that you get more evidence if you just face the player themself rather than looking at it from an awkward angle.

Finally, I have been banned before for "Rudeness" by zacd56 where it was a fair tempban as I was being constantly rude towards other players. I was tempbanned for only 1 DAY which suggests that Pel's ban was far too extreme. I know mods do different things but let's be realstic here I wasn't being that rude here to deserve a 5 day ban. As you can see by the logs it clearly shows what there is and isn't and I hope you can finally see why I believe my ban isn't fair.

PS: Please don't lock this after responses. Thank you :)

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: hcnem
replies.body:
Hello,

Unfortunately, your appeal has been denied. You have 6 previous infractions for the same reason as your most recent tempban. Since you already got a tempban for excessive disrespect, 5 days isn't quite over the top. I find "fucking pel do your job" to be quite disrespectful. Your tempban will expire in three days anyway. 

Regards,
Rinn
Avicus Network Administrator
